headline: Tesla's electric Semi truck reaches the road
summary: Nearly a decade after it was first shown, Tesla's Semi electric truck, with a 500-mile range, is arriving in larger numbers, with Tesla saying it plans to build 50,000 units a year. One report frames the rollout as a milestone for clean transportation, while another says charging-infrastructure gaps still limit electric trucking.
